# Midday alert, Tue 2026-11-10 (~12:30 PM ET)

**Hot CPI hit Waller's 50bp threshold.** Oct CPI +0.4% m/m vs 0.3% expected, core +0.3% vs 0.2%. Waller had said core at 0.3%+ puts a 50bp December hike in play; 50bp odds went from 0% to ~15%, 2-yr up 10–13bp to ~4.70%, 10-yr near 5%. At 11:23 ET: S&P −0.78%, Nasdaq −0.97%, Russell 2000 about −1.4% ([Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/radiocor/finance/dettaglio/us-midday-shares-lower-after-higherthanexpected-inflation-nRC_10112026_1724_604365702.html?lang=en); [TradingNews](https://www.tradingnews.com/news/sp-500-sinks-to-7496-nasdaq-and-dow-fall-as-hit-cpi-revives-half-point-hike-betsd); [NYSE desk](https://e.nyse.com/mac-desk-midday-market-update/)). AI-infra names (GEV, COHR, VRT, MRVL) were down 5%+ pre-open. NVDA −5.4% on new China-shipment allegations (already avoided).

**SKYD −9%:** $200M Q4 adj EBITDA hit from Warner Bros. films ([24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/10/skydance-sinks-9-as-warner-bros-film-slump-overshadows-earnings-beat-netflix-falls-2-disney-dips/)). Added to avoid through 11/13.

**Desk:** No new swing longs today. Rate-sensitive small caps and AI-infra are hit hardest. Close wrap decides whether to extend the AI-hardware avoid past today.
